6951.title: Claude provider forces CLI identity; metering impact unverified
6951.rootCauseOneLine: The session environment forces the CLI entrypoint after configured overrides and removes SDK client-app identity; subscription-meter causality is unverified.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff changes identity and override precedence but supplies no independently verified subscription-meter result; its code was not executed.

6951.proposedFix: First validate the request identity and account-window accounting with an upstream-supported client label, then decide the provider identity and override policy before changing the session environment.
6951.caveats: Two clean checkouts confirm only the bridge-to-SDK environment contract. No real Claude process, subscription, outbound request capture, or usage-meter experiment was run. Existing repository test and exact commands are inline; repository policy forbids separate repro artifacts.
